## Controls

| Action                     | Mouse                                 | Keyboard                   |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| <Change a decision>        | <drag the slider / click the stepper> | <Arrow keys, Page Up/Down> |
| End the <turn unit>        | <click "End the year">                | <Enter>                    |
| Continue from the report   | <click "Continue">                    | <Enter or Space>           |
| Pause and menu             | Pause button                          | Esc                        |
| Play again (results)       | Play again                            | R                          |
| Back to the Hall (results) | Back to the Hall                      | H                          |

## One turn, step by step

1. <Read the report: what happened last turn and why.>
2. <Plan: each decision, its limits and what the live checks warn about.>
3. <Look at the forecast: exact numbers when nothing is left to chance, a range otherwise.>
4. <End the turn. There is no undo after this, by design.>
